body:
### Context
Build client-side drag-and-drop CSV upload dropzone with file picker, format instructions, parse warning notifications, and 1-click "Load Demo Data" trigger.

### Phase
Phase 3: Screener UI & User Experience

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Dropzone in `components/Dropzone.tsx` supports `.csv` drag-and-drop and standard file selection.
- [ ] "Load Demo Data" button instantly loads built-in IDX sample dataset.
- [ ] Parse error/warning alert banner displays skipped rows or schema warnings.
- [ ] Clear/Reset button allows resetting active dataset.

### Verification
Dropping a CSV or clicking Demo loads data and updates active dataset state.

### Blockers
Blocked by #9
